title: Implement the bootstrap/doctor decision table, contract handshake, and minimal-PATH policy-guard self-test
body:
Implement Ticket 3 of the canonical spec .adlc/specs/native-plugin-installation.md (section 5 'Ticket 3', section 4.4) as amended by its NORMATIVE Appendix A (read it first; it overrides the body). Branch feat/t-plugin-03-doctor-handshake in worktree .worktrees/t-plugin-03, stacked on T-PLUGIN-02-ADLC-BRIDGE. lib/adlc-bridge.mjs is FROZEN: import its exports (readPluginContract, KNOWN_ADLC_DEPENDENCY_DIGESTS, BUNDLED_ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_VERSION) and read plugin.json versions in lib/doctor.mjs / lib/bootstrap.mjs using lib/semver.mjs and lib/digest.mjs.

Build (test-first):
1. lib/bootstrap.mjs evaluates ~/.gemini/config/plugins/adlc-antigravity strictly per the section 4.4 Normative Bootstrap & Doctor Decision Table and Unified Evaluation Order, with Appendix A.4 item 16 (pinned 1.7.0: digest mismatch -> corrupt-tree first; digest match with contract absent or !== 1 -> incompatible-contract -> reinstall) and item 17 (semver parsing). Install only via installAdlcAntigravityFromVendor(); never rewrite the companion plugin's files. --force-reinstall always reinstalls. Sibling/env overrides only when unbundled with AGB_DEV_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_PLUGIN=1.
2. lib/doctor.mjs reports the same table outcomes and exit codes (not-installed 1, corrupt-manifest 1, outdated-plugin 1, corrupt-tree 1, incompatible-contract 1, compatible 0 railsTrusted true, compatible (newer-unpinned: vX) 0, tolerant (unconfirmed-contract) 0). Appendix A E10: run the exact hooks.json command string under PATH=/usr/bin:/bin against a temp fixture repo whose active ticket declares rails ["lib/lock.mjs"]; parse the single output line as JSON; assert decision === 'deny' and reason includes 'Target path matches frozen rail: lib/lock.mjs'; a second payload on lib/foo.mjs must yield empty stdout and exit 0. Write rails-guard-health.json (nodeSha256, bundleSha256, hooksSha256, railsTrusted, timestamp) as an informational log only. D10: an npm-global agb on PATH is a warning ('secondary install detected; prefer ~/.local/bin/agb'). D15: report AGB_HOOK_DISABLE killswitch notices counted from hooks.log. P4: warn if any probe-* plugin is installed.
3. CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.

Acceptance criteria:
1. `npm test` passes with new tests: test/doctor-contract.test.mjs (one case per decision-table row for both bootstrap and doctor, temp HOME fixtures, injected digest map for the pinned-contract row), test/doctor-selftest.test.mjs (minimal PATH; exact reason substring; non-rail empty-stdout check; deleting, corrupting or forging rails-guard-health.json changes no hook decision), test/bootstrap-install.test.mjs (uses test/fixtures/fake-agy extended to emulate `plugin install` / `uninstall` / `validate` into a temp HOME — never the real agy; tarball extracts into a dedicated adlc-antigravity directory and temp staging is removed on success and error; bootstrap from the staged directory does not truncate or misname it; a git ls-files copy with no node_modules installs from vendor cache and doctor then reports compatible).
2. Doctor on a clean clone (`node dist/agb.mjs doctor` with HOME set to an empty temp dir) exits 1 reporting not-installed with no uncaught exception on stderr; verified in test/clean-clone.test.mjs.
3. `adlc rails-guard --base <T2 merge commit> --ticket T-PLUGIN-03-DOCTOR-HANDSHAKE` exits 0 (lib/adlc-bridge.mjs, bin/node-launcher.sh, bin/hook-runner.sh, lib/lock.mjs, lib/gates.mjs untouched).
4. `npm run build && git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all dist/ vendor/` prints nothing.
5. `adlc hollow-test --test-cmd "npm test" --base <T2 merge commit>` has no survivors in lib/doctor.mjs decision-table code or lib/bootstrap.mjs.
6. `npx adversarial-review --base <T2 merge commit>` exits 0.
